correctness.rationale: Any shattered nonempty F lies in a sphere of one center; XOR translation anchors F as a collection of weight-2 vertices, encoded by edges of a simple graph. For a center of weight w, the trace on each edge e depends on |supp(c)∩e|=w/2, forcing w∈{0,2,4} for nonempty traces. At most four spare coordinates suffice for all possible patterns, with empty/full granted. Enumerating all unlabeled graphs with 6 edges via complete edge-addition recursion gives counts 1,2,5,11,26,68 and maximum only 49 of 64 six-edge patterns, hence no shattered 6-set in any dimension. An independently implemented NetworkX isomorphism-recursion and different trace-mask computation reproduced all counts and max 49. Direct checks exclude k+1 shattered sets in d=3,4,5,6 after respectively 1,20,210,3003 candidates, and find witnesses size 2,2,3,4. For d≥7 the 5-edge star plus spare-coordinate center constructions realize all 32 traces; d1,d2 are immediate. Infinite-dimension assertion rests on the mathematical support reduction plus full finite kernel, not finite experiments alone.
